device.description: 16-bit buffered voltage-output DAC with SPI, LDAC, clear and power-up zero/mid-scale select
device.note: dac161s055.pdf (SNAS503B) p.2-3 connection diagram and pin descriptions, p.4 operating ratings (VA 2.7-5.25 V, VDDIO 1.7 V to VA, digital inputs 0 to VDDIO), p.7-8 digital interface timing and Figures 1-2, p.14-15 serial interface (24-bit FIFO, SPI read, daisy chain), p.16-17 write-through/block, LDAC, write commands, clear, power-on reset, power down, p.18 internal registers, p.19-20 instruction set

registers.name: PREREG
registers.note: p.18 DAC preload data register; power-up value set by the MZB pin (0 or mid-scale; 0 modeled)

registers.name: DACREG
registers.note: p.18 DAC output data register; power-up value set by MZB (0 modeled)

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: p.18 configuration reporting register (bits 7-3 reserved, not stored); only commands change it; RDCO default 0004h (SWB = 1 write block)

commands.name: CLR
commands.note: clear internal registers, return to the power-up default state

commands.name: LDAC
commands.note: software load DAC: CHANNEL[0] = 1 moves PREREG to DACREG

commands.name: SWB
commands.note: CHANNEL[0]: 1 write block, 0 write through (default 00FFh: block)

commands.name: PD 10K (both set)
commands.note: upper and lower CHANNEL[0] both 1: power down with 10k to GND

commands.name: PD off
commands.note: writing the PD command with the bit 0 exits power down

commands.name: WR (write through)
commands.note: SWB = 0: PREREG and DACREG updated at CSB rising

commands.name: WRUP
commands.note: update PREREG and DACREG regardless of SWB

commands.name: WRAL
commands.note: update all channels' PREREG and DACREG (one channel here)

commands.name: RDDO
commands.note: read PREREG: the next transaction shifts out the command byte and the register

commands.name: other word (echo)
commands.note: any other 24-bit word (reserved commands, channels other than 0): no action; the FIFO still returns it on SDO

protocol.note: 24-bit word (8-bit command + 16-bit data) sampled on SCLK rising; decoded from the last 24 bits before CSB rises; SDO shifts out the previous word (the FIFO), or the register for a preceding read command

pages: p.2-3 (pins), p.4 (operating ratings), p.7-8 (timing, Figures 1-2), p.14-15 (serial interface, SPI read, daisy chain), p.16-17 (write-block/through, LDAC, write commands, clear, POR, power down), p.18 (registers), p.19-20 (instruction set)
notModeled: analog output, reference, settling and the power-down output termination (SEL_10K/SEL_HIZ stored only)
CLR command resets the registers (action reset); per the datasheet it returns to the power-up state set by MZB
SDO FIFO: on longer frames (daisy chain) SDO outputs SDI delayed by 24 SCLKs; the model shifts out only the previous 24-bit word, then zeros
SDO contents after power-up (the FIFO) are not given: zeros
tValid/tOut/tFloat use the VDDIO 1.7-1.8 V limits (tZSDO 40 ns, tDO 62 ns, tSDOZ 75 ns)
LDACB/CLRB must not change while CSB is low: not checked
variants: the instruction set is shared with multichannel DAC16xS055 parts; only channel 0 exists here
